subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the first CLI surface for this issue be read-only pending/list JSON output only, or should it also include resolve/respond and watch behavior from the active related PR?
rationale: The remaining source gap is clear, but listing pending command text and especially resolving approvals from CLI affects an operator security boundary that needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Ship List/JSON First
options.body: Expose read-only `openclaw approvals pending`/`list` through the existing `exec.approval.list` RPC and defer resolve/respond and watch semantics to follow-up review.

options.title: Adopt Broader CLI Control
options.body: Use the active PR direction and require security/proof coverage for both listing and resolving pending approvals before merge.

options.title: Defer CLI Exposure
options.body: Keep pending approval inspection in existing UI/MCP/backend paths until maintainers decide the CLI contract is worth the security surface.

recommendation.title: Ship List/JSON First
recommendation.body: Expose read-only `openclaw approvals pending`/`list` through the existing `exec.approval.list` RPC and defer resolve/respond and watch semantics to follow-up review.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the approvals CLI/docs surface and has already provided concrete scoping guidance on this issue.
